name: std::discard_block_engine<Engine,P,R>::discard
intro: Advances the internal state by z times. Equivalent to calling operator() z times and discarding the result. The state of the underlying engine may be advanced by more than z times.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
z

 -

 integer value specifying the number of times to advance the state by

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Two engines start with seed 42. Advancing one by discard(3) matches three calls to the other.
